title: Ministry of the Interior: live investment monitoring
excerpt: How a national entity moved from monthly spreadsheet reports to a dashboard with real-time alerts on projects and contracts.
content:
How a national entity moved from monthly spreadsheet reports to a dashboard with real-time alerts on projects and contracts.

The starting point

Operations ran on a monthly cycle: each department consolidated its information, someone merged it all, and a report was produced. The document accurately described a situation that had already changed.

What was implemented

  • Consolidation of projects and contracts into a single dashboard.
  • Progress reporting directly from the construction site, with evidence.
  • Automatic alerts for schedule deviations and contracts without supporting documents.
  • Role-based access: contractor, inspector, supervisor and senior management.

The fundamental change wasn't technological: the conversation shifted from what happened to what we do next.

Observable results

[KPI] 87%::Execution tracked live | +412::Alerts handled per period | 98.4%::Document traceability

The lesson

Adoption doesn't depend on the software but on every stakeholder's commitment to feeding it. Once contractors understand that accurate reporting speeds up their own payments, the system sustains itself.
